meta.grade_scale: xfv_grade is THE board number: the displayed grade, the sort key and the basis of overall_rank (storage.BOARD_GRADE_FIELD). Since 2026-07-30 it is value_framework.outcome_implied_fv(E[6yr WAR]) -- the inverse of the POOLED empirical outcome curve fitted on resolved cohorts (data/fv_outcome_curves_pooled.json), so a grade states the FV whose measured first-six-year bWAR matches this prediction. It is a pure function of predicted WAR: unlike the retired map it takes no age or position, so two rows with equal predictions grade equally. Below about FV45 the curve is flat and the sub-floor knots are a shape-preserving re-spread, so a sub-45 grade is NOT outcome-calibrated and must not be read as one. xfv_grade_quantile is the RETIRED per-side quantile map onto the consensus distribution; it is no longer displayed but surplus_mm is still priced through it, which is why the refit moved zero dollars. p_bucket / p_bust stay on the retired realized_implied_fv map on purpose (they were ground-truthed on it and a re-key has not been measured). Live board players carry kind=active + a surplus dist; they require a pro track record (eFV abstains on players with no MiLB production).
